findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司在全球銷售，美國關稅政策、出口管制或其他貿易限制的變動難以預測，可能對公司造成重大不利影響；現任政府已對中國、加拿大、墨西哥進口品加稅。
findings.excerpt: Significant political, trade, or regulatory developments in the jurisdictions in which we sell our products, including changes in tariff policies by the U.S. administration, export controls, or other trade restrictions, are difficult to predict and may have a material adverse effect on us.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：2025 年中國擴大稀土出口管制；2025 年 11 月美中協議中國同意暫停擴大管制與報復性關稅；此情勢帶來供應鏈波動與對非中國供應鏈的需求增加，可能對公司產品需求有重大影響。
findings.excerpt: While in November 2025 the U.S. reached a trade and economic deal in which China agreed to suspend implementation of the expanded export controls and to suspend retaliatory tariffs and non-tariff measures imposed since March 2025, these developments have led and continue to lead to several market trends

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：精礦售價以扣除稅、關稅後的暫定市價計；DoW 協議與 Apple、GM 供應協議提供需求確定性，但美中等國貿易政策變動（新增或調整關稅）仍可能影響流動性。
findings.excerpt: further changes in trade policies in the United States, China or other countries, including the implementation of new tariffs, increases in or reductions of existing tariffs, or the taking of other actions.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋摘要顯示 2026-06-22 中國將 MP 列入出口管制清單（多家媒體，日期有 6/15 與 6/22 出入），另有 232 關鍵礦物公告與中國磁鐵 25% 關稅（2026 起），皆未讀到頁面，放 clues。
